wiki.title: Bill Wesley
wiki.extract: Bill E. Wesley (born October 26, 1971) is an American politician. He serves as a Republican member of the Kentucky House of Representatives from Kentucky's 91st House district. His district includes Estill and Powell counties as well as part of Madison County.
